properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 14 at 9:03PM MDT until August 15 at 9:00PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall over Bijou Creek is
expected.

* WHERE...Northern Elbert County in east central Colorado...
Central Adams County in northeastern Colorado...
Arapahoe County in northeastern Colorado...
Southwestern Morgan County in northeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 900 PM MDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding along Bijou Creek.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 858 PM MDT, Up to five inches of heavy rainfall fell on
Friday evening. Elevated creek waters are expected to cause minor
flooding along Bijou Creek over the next 15 to 18 hours as the
water makes its way north to the South Platte River.

- This includes the following streams and drainages...
West Bijou Creek and Bijou Creek.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Hoyt and Byers.
